verdict.rationale: An eval and observability platform with an AI agent (Loop) and prompt playgrounds could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Braintrust's own MCP server, which lets external clients like Claude Code or Cursor connect to Braintrust. That is the server role, not the ability to plug outside MCP servers into Braintrust or Loop. The API's mention of managing 'tools' is not tied to MCP, so nothing shows MCP-client support.
